goals: Preserve the exact accepted C6 compatibility layer for Quick Stack Nearby 0.4.0 across Inventory Extended player storage, CNM ShapeMap families, vanilla shelf exclusion, and the demonstrated Inventory Search interoperability seam.

Keep Quick Stack Nearby responsible for discovery, target order, access checks, legal insertion, components, capacities, remainders, rules, persistence, and feedback while consuming only the existing optional owners' narrow public or proven seams.
Retain the immutable accepted C6 artifact and the distinct runtime-passed C4 rollback with their exact source and evidence boundaries.
scope: Maintain the twelve production Java classes and three production resources from legacy C6 source commit 3c8cc5917da9fd016e57a969955fa7c6e3b08661; only local reference-JAR path resolution is normalized for the Mynx build layout.
Extend QSN's player source and rule window to the live ordinary non-equipment inventory range while excluding hotbar, equipment, offhand, crafting/result, Trinkets, trash, and foreign menu slots.

Admit destinations through exact Clutter No More ShapeMap equivalence and its native merge path so the existing destination geometry wins without a second material database, conversion engine, or source-variant collapse.
Filter only vanilla ShelfBlockEntity targets after QSN discovery, preserving every surviving target object and order.

Retain C5's base-only QSN button offset and C6's soft Inventory Sort Core result correction only for the real player InventoryScreen when both Inventory Search and Inventory Extended are loaded; Inventory Search continues to own its native widget lifecycle.
Retain exact C4 as the distinct focused-runtime-pass rollback and preserve the failed C5 result textually rather than as a current or rollback artifact.

exclusions: Carried Container Auto-Routing, Matcha × Stack to Nearby Chests Compatibility, Inventory Search, Block Geometry Extensions, Nibaru, Clutter No More, Quick Stack Nearby, and every other nearby-routing or inventory project retain their own identities, source, artifacts, and behavior ownership.

No Stack to Nearby Chests implementation, Matcha-specific QSN adapter, general Inventory Search patch, carried-container routing, nested-container routing, reserved-slot redesign, registry-name parsing, fuzzy material equivalence, item conversion, or custom stack merge is owned here.
Official QSN, Inventory Search/Core, Inventory Extended, Clutter No More, BGE, Nibaru, Minecraft, and Fabric classes or JARs are not bundled or redistributed by this project.

The C6 aggregate runtime pass does not establish individual checklist rows, dedicated-server coverage, later Nibaru/CNM-integration pair coverage, or compatibility with an unrecorded dependency identity.
This migration does not deploy, retest, promote, alter either Test Slot or the accepted physical baseline, mutate Test Instance Manager state, launch Minecraft, or access either gameplay profile.
